card.name: Linking words in UK place descriptions
card.fires_on: Small linking words and commas right before or between British place names, such as Lake District towns, mountains and rivers. It appears in travel, history or biography text about northern England and Scotland.

modes.label: Prepositions before place names
modes.description: Words like in, between or of that come just before a named UK location.
modes.example: His family, including Dorothy, moved to Rydal Mount, Ambleside (<<between>> Grasmere and Rydal Water)

modes.label: Commas in place lists
modes.description: Commas separating names in a list of Scottish landmarks.
modes.example: The Trust cares for land at Glencoe<<,>> Kintail, Mar Lodge Estate,

modes.label: Footpath conservation advice
modes.description: Linking words in tips about protecting mountain paths.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mixed and unclear, so the output effect is weak.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words just before place names in text about the Lake District and Scottish hills.
